abstract: The frequency of germ cell neoplasms in girls with 46-XY gonadal dysgenesis suggests that germ cells may persist in the dysgenetic gonads for many years. A phenotypic female infant with a karyotype of 46-XY in blood, skin, and gonads had a few ova in primordial follicles and numerous germ cells in her dysgenetic gonads at the age of 3 months. At 3 years and 10 months of age her gonads contained no primordial follicle and the only remaining germ cells were in a gonadoblastoma. We propose that germ cells are lost from dysgenetic gonads much more rapidly than from normal gonads, but that the rate of loss in patients with a karyotype of 46-XY may be less than the rate of loss in patients with a karyotype of 45-XO.
abstract_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成における胚細胞腫瘍の頻度から、胚細胞は異形成性生殖腺に長期間残存する可能性が示唆される。生後3か月の表現型女児（血液、皮膚、生殖腺で46,XY）は、原始卵胞内に少数の卵と、異形成性生殖腺に多数の胚細胞を有していた。3歳10か月の時点では、生殖腺に原始卵胞はなく、残存する胚細胞は性腺芽腫内のみであった。異形成性生殖腺からの胚細胞の消失は正常生殖腺より速いと考えられるが、46,XYの患者における消失速度は45,XOの患者より遅い可能性がある。
